 Flat wire winding, achieving a low DC resistance.
 The inductance value and DC bias characteristic are little affected by
temperature.
 Magnetically shielded structure, excellent resistance to electromagnetic
interference.
 Compact design saves PCB mounting area.

 Core material: Composite.
 Core and winding loss:

(Unlimited floor life at <30°C / 85% relative humidity)
 Operating temperature range: -55℃～+155℃
(Including coil’s temperature rise).
 Storage temperature range: -40℃～+125℃
Application：
 PV inverter/Industrial control/New energy
 DC /DC converters/Motherboards/Filter
 High current switching regulators
